name: legal-terminus-ios-prod
description: Legal Terminus iPhone app, PRODUCTION. A Capacitor shell around the Portal (Portal/dist-mobile). This folder can only build the production app (com.legalterminus.app); the QA app is iOSApp/.

scripts.build:web: LT_APP_ENV=production node ../MobileShared/scripts/app-env.mjs && cd ../Portal && npm run build:mobile && cd ../iOSAppProd && LT_APP_ENV=production node ../MobileShared/scripts/check-bundle.mjs production
scripts.sync: LT_APP_ENV=production npm run build:web && LT_APP_ENV=production cap sync ios
